'''Speng''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] who operated the [[Umbra Club]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and nightclub situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Speng encountered a band of [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]] operatives who had been hired to track down the errant [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kaa'to Leeachos]].<ref name="UABS" />
